name: Audio Player
description: Play mono or stereo audio, accepting .wav files, numpy arrays, and Source objects.

inputParameters.name: sound
inputParameters.description: Audio file path, numpy array, or Source object.

inputParameters.name: sample_rate
inputParameters.description: Sample rate of a numpy array sound, in Hz, e.g. from the Auralise component. Default is the project sample rate.

inputParameters.name: normalize
inputParameters.description: Whether to scale a numpy array sound to full level before playing (default True). Disable it to hear auralised signals at their rendered level.
